estimand.description: hba1c ~ 1 + age10 + female + bmi5 + glucose10; term age10 with stated centering/scaling; equal-age-sex-cell WLS.
estimand.scale: Linear association coefficient on the requested centered/scaled exposure, not a causal effect.
estimand.population: Mexico analytical-use design: adults aged 25-79 with no reported prior doctor diagnosis of diabetes/high blood sugar, recorded 8-12-hour fast, positive fasting serum glucose below 126 mg/dL, available HbA1c and valid standing anthropometry with internally consistent measurement documentation (uniformly excluding explicit not-weighed or alternative-standing-route documentation that contradicts usable standing measurements, without asserting which field is correct) under the prespecified measurement restrictions; pregnancy/lactation excluded when documented by questionnaire routing for women aged 25-49; no verified medication or anemia exclusion. Exactly 375 fictional individuals per female=0/1 crossed with age bands 25-39, 40-54, 55-69, 70-79; equal-stratum analytical design, not a nationally representative population.
estimand.measurement: Target HbA1c percent, fasting serum glucose mg/dL, BMI kg/m^2, integer age years and female0/1.

analyses.rationale: Source coefficient requires unresolved transport and adjustment/scale assumptions.

evidence_links.rationale: Reported same outcome-exposure coefficient with explicit scale/context bridges. Reported0.010 percentage points/year, P<0.001; SE/CI absent. Model transfers after multiplying by10 for requested age10 effect. Serum/plasma, population, design and selection bridges remain assumptions.

Component or contextual evidence, not the requested coefficient. Weighted marginal mean within source age band; generated equal-cell data do not reconstruct this source. Reference50-54 mean alone is a fitted anchor.

Component or contextual evidence, not the requested coefficient. Weighted97.5th percentile; exact quantile interpolation convention not reported. Reference50-54 mean and quantile imply an assumed normal-shape SD, not a reported SD.
Component or contextual evidence, not the requested coefficient. Context/check only; SE0.00081, P<0.0001. Adjustment omits BMI/glucose. Tables2/5/6 show age-sex heterogeneity not modeled here.
Component or contextual evidence, not the requested coefficient. Context/check only; P<0.001; ungenerated2-hour glucose prevents matching. Same publication as NHANES, distinct cohort.

gaps.description: Source countries and sampling weights differ from the Mexico equal-cell design.
gaps.consequence: Transported coefficients/moments are not target estimates.

gaps.description: Assay/serum-plasma correspondence and Finnish outcome units are not directly established.
gaps.consequence: Numerical use needs explicit measurement and inferred-unit bridges.

gaps.description: Diagnosis, fasting, medication and HbA1c restrictions differ.
gaps.consequence: Selection can alter the requested relationships.

gaps.description: Component moments condition on source subgroups or marginalize different covariates.
gaps.consequence: Reference covariates and marginal-correlation transport remain assumptions.

gaps.description: Binary age, fasting adjustment, or marginal component statistics differ from requested adjustment.
gaps.consequence: A usable target-adjusted coefficient is not automatically identified.

gaps.description: Requested terms use10-year/5-BMI scales; some source outcome units are absent.
gaps.consequence: Recorded conversion/inference must not be relabelled as reported raw units.

gaps.description: The complete joint distribution and missing conditional glucose/BMI relation are not supplied by one source.
gaps.consequence: Derived coefficient depends on coherent but unverified cross-source compatibility.

gaps.description: Age/sex heterogeneity is present in contextual evidence and unreported for the target.
gaps.consequence: Common slopes may fail under target interactions.

gaps.description: No calibrated joint transport uncertainty is available.
gaps.consequence: Fixed parameters/seed variation cannot supply clinical inferential certainty.

actions.request: Need directly comparable source context/joint moments, source weighting definitions and conditional HbA1c-BMI-glucose association; retain gaps until admissible evidence identifies them.
actions.reason: Admitted sources do not identify these missing quantities. Three limited gateway searches found no usable new conditional coefficient; one credit remains, but no promising record currently justifies another action. No target or individual source records may be used. This is not a claim of literature exhaustion.
